title_zh: 受贿1.44亿余元，段成刚被判无期
title_en: Duan Chenggang Sentenced to Life Imprisonment for Bribery of Over 144 Million Yuan
summary_zh: 2026年7月28日，重庆市政协原副主席段成刚因受贿1.44亿余元被判处无期徒刑。
summary_en: On July 28, 2026, Duan Chenggang, former vice chairman of Chongqing Municipal CPPCC, was sentenced to life imprisonment for accepting bribes totaling over 144 million yuan.
